items.title: Show HN: KronLSTM Walkthrough
items.contentSnippet:
KronLSTM launched!
KronLSTM is built on the Kronecker Delta Rule: instead of correcting the vector stored at a key, it corrects a single scalar, how strongly this key is bound to this value. An existing association is disturbed only if both its key AND its value overlap with the new pair (Klambauer).
Enjoy a short walkthrough of the net.

items.title: Show HN: Saltmere, a browser-based city builder about sea-level rise
items.contentSnippet:
I built Saltmere to show how the rise in sea level might affect coastal cities, and what can be done to cope with the effects. The projections are based on real research (IPCC AR6 projections for the Hoek van Holland tide gauge; tides, weather effects and economy are designed to make the game challenging and fun to play), and there are various strategies one can adopt to try and mitigate the impacts.
